name: biceps curl arms body (form check)
description: A side-by-side form check for arm and body position during a biceps curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms forward.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows stay pinned at your sides and your torso does not swing.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
